tasks.name: 1D Stefan moving-boundary inverse problem viability study
tasks.deliverable: src/data/spatial_reconstruction/stefan_inverse.py: enthalpy-method 1D Stefan forward solver, joint 4-parameter inverse fitter (x_core, alpha_dough, alpha_crust, rhoL_eff), Hessian-based confidence + correlation matrix, plus a literature-pinned 1-parameter variant. tests/test_stefan_inverse_research.py: forward-solver classical-Stefan-Neumann analytical sanity test, synthetic ground-truth recovery (DON'T self-test), real-CSV viability sweep (joint + pinned modes). tests/_driver_stefan_inverse.py: end-to-end driver. tests/baselines/stefan_inverse_research.md: report with per-fixture RMSE comparison (Stefan-joint vs Stefan-pinned vs M7 heat-eq baseline), parameter correlation matrix table, free-fit alpha values vs literature, and verdict. NOT wired into runtime classifier.
tasks.validation_required: Forward solver matches classical Stefan-Neumann analytical solution within 1 deg C on a textbook synthetic. Joint inverse runs to convergence on at least 5 of 7 real CSVs. Pinned 1-parameter fit runs on all 7. Driver completes within 30 min wall-clock at downsample_factor=4. Existing M1-M8 tests untouched (stefan_inverse.py is research-only).
